text:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners for prompt/regression, replayable load, nightly gating, and a chaos drill. Who can pick what with rough ETA?

Carlos: I'll own the prompt/regression seeds. 3 days to curate + 1 day to add to evals runner. Will label failure classes.

Priya: I can wire the nightly job and alerts (Grafana + alert rules). Need /metrics from eval runner. ETA 4 days.

Tom: I'll build the replayable load harness (steady, burst, sequence-edge). Need sandbox infra. Estimate 4-5 days.

Maya: Perfect. Action map: prompts -> Carlos (4d), nightly + alerts -> Priya (4d), load harness -> Tom (5d), chaos drill coordination -> Maya (2d). I'll open a tracking issue.

Carlos: PR incoming with 100 seeds: https://git.internal/redwood/evals/pulls/502. Will add prometheus /metrics (truncations_total, requests_total, hallucinations_total).

Priya: Once /metrics exists I'll add the presubmit smoke job (200 seeds) and nightly full-run. Presubmit blocks if truncation regresses >2%. Nightly alerts ops if >1.5% for 3 runs.

Tom: Ops-bot, can you make the sandbox ticket? Need pinned model artifact for deterministic replays.

Ops-bot: INF-6120 created: provision GPU sandbox and snapshot deterministic model image. ETA 3 business days.

Maya: I'll link PR + infra in the tracking issue and schedule 15m weekly check-ins. First check-in next Wed. If timelines slip, flag here.

Carlos: Got it. Adding failure tags to the PR.

Priya: Will draft Grafana panels and attach to the issue.

Tom: I'll push repo skeleton once INF-6120 is ready.

Maya: Thanks team.
